reasoning: The question asks whether Nikkei 225 will increase from March 15 to March 22, 2026. The evidence shows the index has been in a strong uptrend in early 2026, reaching new highs around 58,875 in late February 2026, with analysts projecting 60,000+ by year-end. However, for any given week, stock indices have roughly 50-55% probability of increasing due to slight positive drift. The recent strong performance and bullish sentiment provide modest support for continued gains, but short-term movements are inherently unpredictable. Given the positive trend context but acknowledging weekly randomness, I estimate slightly above base rate.
